page.layout: One text column at full width, with a handwritten manuscript annotation in the left margin. No notes printed in the margins. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.p: Ex uerbo nascitur controuersia, cum obscurum & ambiguum scriptum pronūciatum ue uerbum est. Quod genus (ut ait Cicero) non argumentando tractatur, sed tanquam explicando excutien-doq; uerbo. Veluti cum quaeritur quid sit penus, quid ruta caesa, quid instrumentum, de quo ipso exēplum ex Ser-uio Iurisc. proferemus. Instrumentum quidam omne Titio legauit. eo mortuo, frumētum quod cultorum cibarijs paratum erat, Titius petit. In tetio[?]: Debes mihi hoc frumētum. D. Non debeo. R. An debeat.

page.notes: The left margin carries a handwritten annotation in manuscript hand (not printed), so it is not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "tetio" (the speaker name, possibly Titio) and "tractatur" (the ligature is hard to read). The running head is too faint to read. The line "Iurisc.proferemus" lacks a printed space, which is left as printed. The apostrophe in "pronūciatum'ue" is uncertain.
